jobs.title: Conseiller(ère) en coordination Microsoft 365
jobs.description:
Conseiller(ère) en coordination Microsoft 365

Mode de travail : Télétravail (présence au Québec requise)
Horaire : Temps plein (35 heures/semaine)

Vous souhaitez contribuer à des projets technologiques d'envergure?
Nous recherchons un(e) Conseiller(ère) en coordination Microsoft 365
pour se joindre à une équipe responsable de l'évolution et de l'administration d'un environnement Microsoft 365 à très grande échelle. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous agirez comme point de convergence entre les équipes opérationnelles, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les équipes techniques afin d'assurer la coordination et l'avancement de dossiers prioritaires.
Vous aurez l'occasion de travailler sur des initiatives ayant un impact concret auprès d'un vaste réseau d'utilisateurs et de collaborer avec de nombreux intervenants dans un environnement complexe et stimulant.

Votre rôle
Planifier, coordonner et assurer le suivi des dossiers qui vous sont confiés.
Assurer la liaison entre les équipes techniques, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les instances décisionnelles.
Coordonner les activités, les échéanciers, les risques, les enjeux et les dépendances de plusieurs dossiers simultanément.
Produire et maintenir les tableaux de bord, indicateurs et rapports d'avancement.
Participer aux activités de gouvernance et à la reddition de comptes.
Soutenir la gestion du changement et les communications auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques de gestion et de coordination.
Vulgariser des concepts et enjeux techniques auprès d'intervenants non techniques.

Profil recherché
Exigences
Baccalauréat en technologies de l'information ou dans un domaine pertinent, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience.
Minimum de 8 années d'expérience pertinente en gestion ou coordination de dossiers, mandats ou projets complexes.
Expérience significative de coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires et de collaboration avec de multiples parties prenantes.
Expérience démontrée en planification, suivi d'échéanciers, gestion des risques, enjeux et dépendances.
Expérience des approches de gestion de projet Agile, hybride ou traditionnelle.

Expertise recherchée
Excellente connaissance de l'environnement Microsoft 365 et de ses composantes.
Bonne compréhension d'Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint et OneDrive.
Compréhension des concepts liés à la gestion des identités et des adresses courriel (UPN, alias, adresses principales, synchronisation Active Directory, groupes, boîtes partagées).
Capacité à coordonner plusieurs intervenants et dossiers en parallèle dans un contexte organisationnel complexe.

Atouts
Certifications en gestion de projet ou en agilité (PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, SAFe ou équivalent).
Maîtrise en gestion de projet.
Expérience dans le secteur public ou dans un environnement de grande envergure.

Ce qui vous distingue
Leadership mobilisateur.
Excellentes habiletés de communication et de collaboration.
Sens de l'organisation et gestion efficace des priorités.
Esprit d'analyse et capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes.
Rigueur et orientation vers les résultats.

Pourquoi joindre ce projet?
Mandat stratégique dans un environnement technologique à grande échelle.
Forte exposition aux technologies Microsoft 365.
Collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires expertes.
Télétravail majoritaire.
Occasion d'avoir un impact tangible sur des initiatives organisationnelles majeures.

Vous aimez coordonner des dossiers complexes, travailler avec divers intervenants et faire avancer des initiatives technologiques d'envergure? Nous souhaitons vous rencontrer.

We support clients across Canada, including Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Alberta, and Saskatchewan.

: Full-time, Permanent

: $40,000.00 – $50,000.00 per year (entry-level, based on experience)

About LP & Associates

LP & Associates is a growing IT Managed Services & Security Provider (MSP) supporting small and mid-sized businesses across North America. We deliver responsive IT support, cybersecurity services, and infrastructure projects across Microsoft 365, cloud, and on-prem environments.

About the Role

We are hiring a Level 1 IT Support Specialist / Help Desk Technician to join our remote MSP team.

This is an entry-level role, ideal for:
Recent graduates
Candidates currently completing post-secondary IT studies
Self-taught technologists
Anyone early in their IT career looking to gain hands-on MSP experience

You will focus on first-line technical support, ticket triage, and routine IT tasks, with mentorship and clear escalation paths to senior technicians.

You are not expected to know everything on day one - you are expected to be reliable, curious, and willing to learn.

Key Responsibilities

Level 1 IT Support / Help Desk
Provide first-line technical support to end users (remote)
Triage incoming help desk tickets and follow documented procedures
Troubleshoot common issues involving:
Windows Windows 11
Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive)
Assist with user onboarding and offboarding (accounts, permissions, MFA)
Perform routine tasks using RMM tools (monitoring, alerts, basic remediation)
Maintain clear, accurate ticket notes and documentation
Escalate issues appropriately when outside Level 1 scope

Learning & Development

Shadow senior technicians on more complex issues
Assist with project work as needed
Build skills across MSP tools, security practices, and client environments

Tools You’ll Be Exposed To

Datto RMM
Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD)
Remote support tools
Documentation platforms (IT Glue or similar)
Endpoint security tools (EDR/MDR exposure over time)

Qualifications

High school diploma (or equivalent)
Post-secondary education in IT (completed or in progress), or equivalent hands-on experience
(self-taught candidates welcome)
Basic understanding of:
Windows operating systems
Microsoft 365 fundamentals
User accounts and permissions
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Reliable internet connection and home workspace
High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail

Nice to Have

Any help desk or MSP experience
CompTIA A+ or similar entry-level certification
Interest in PowerShell or automation
Personal computing projects or a home lab

Bonus Points

Have a home lab? Whether it’s a few Raspberry Pis, a server rack, or a virtualized test environment - we want to hear about it
Tinkerer mindset - enjoys experimenting, learning new tools, or automating tasks

Perks & Benefits

Remote-first flexibility - work from home by default
Private Health Services Plan (PHSP) – tax-free reimbursement for:
Dental care
Prescription medications
Medical services not covered by provincial plans
Vision care
Chiropractic, massage, physiotherapy, and more
Signed T2200 to support eligible remote work expense claims
Exposure to cloud, security, networking, and virtualization technologies
Diverse client environments across multiple industries
Certification support and mentorship
Bonus potential based on performance and contribution
Supportive, no-ego team culture focused on growth

Application Instructions

Apply with your resume and include a brief note about your home lab, personal projects, or technical interests.
Applicants who skip this will not be considered - curiosity matters here.

LP & Associates

LP&A supports clients across Canada and North America, with service reach and team presence in Toronto, Sudbury and Thunder Bay, Ontario; Montréal, Quebec; Winnipeg, Manitoba; Regina and Saskatoon, Saskatchewan; Edmonton and Lethbridge, Alberta; Langley, British Columbia; Moncton, New Brunswick; Halifax, Nova Scotia; and Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island.

IT Managed Services Provider (MSP), Cybersecurity/MDR, AI, Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS and Networking Services.

Routinely troubleshoot for problem/solution identification

Working level knowledge of food and water treatment fundamentals, practices, and terminology

Not just another entry level career opportunity: receive coaching, mentorship, and support at every step of your career journey. We invest in you so you can thrive and succeed.

Launch your tech career with FDM – any degree welcomed

We match your strengths to the right role.
Opportunities could include, but not limited to:

Quality Engineer

Test software manually and with tools like Selenium and Cucumber, ensuring reliability, performance, and seamless user experiences across every release.

Cloud Developer

Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure using Java and React, optimizing for performance, scalability, and resilience.

Software Engineer

Design and build full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React, delivering scalable, secure, and responsive digital experiences.

About You

What’s in it for you?

Fast-track your career with 6-12 weeks initial upskilling courses facilitated by our expert coaches, followed by practice-based learning catered to industry demand
Opportunity to work on exciting, business-critical projects with top-tier companies in banking & finance, insurance, retail, and more
Dive into delivering solutions across the application lifecycle

You hold a university degree level (bachelor or higher)
Able to commit to at least two years of employment with FDM as a consultant following the initial training period
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, paired with great interpersonal and communication skills
Eligible to work in Canada

🌍 Global impact – 19 centers across North America, APAC, the UK, and Europe
🚀 25,000+ careers launched – and counting
🤝 300+ trusted client partners
